name: RC-B10-0260/2026 – § 12 – Am 7
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the repression and execution of protesters, dissidents, political prisoners and religious minorities in Iran
part_text: 12.Calls on the VP/HR, the Council and Member States to make human rights, the release of all political prisoners, an end to executions, and accountability for the victimscoreelements of any engagement to end the ongoing war and of any future governance of Iran;
